title: AI-Powered Agricultural Contact Center for Farmers
summary: POTRAZ describes pilots in three wards using voice and SMS agricultural advice. The chapter's income, loss-reduction, and adoption figures are projections.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: POTRAZ describes pilots in three wards using voice and SMS agricultural advice. The chapter's income, loss-reduction, and adoption figures are projections. Three pilot wards / product development.
purpose: Give farmers localized advice through basic phones and local languages.
location: Mashonaland West and Masvingo provinces, Zimbabwe

ratings.reason: Zimbabwean farmers are intended to receive accessible advice and increase income; the 25% income gain and 40% loss reduction are projections.
Agricultural extension organizations are intended to expand service coverage.
Food security and climate resilience are intended, with no attributable public outcome.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 3: AI-Powered Agricultural Contact Center for Farmers

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Basic-phone access and agricultural information services

headline: Zimbabwe pilots an agricultural voice-advice center

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
